    Literal factor categories of finite right-module categories #

    This file constructs the manuscript's categorical quotient by morphisms factoring through the additive closure of a selected set of indecomposable modules. It deliberately stops before the factor tau-sequences: the quotient category, its linear and additive structures, its finite biproducts, and its surviving skeleton are the reusable substrate for that construction.
